sections.text_helper: Section 23.8.2 "Comparator interrupt clear flag register (COMP_ICFR)" in chapter 23 (Comparator (COMP)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 721.
sections.section_content:
The COMP_ICFR is the comparator interrupt clear flag register.
Address offset: 0x04
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:18 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 17 CC2IF: Clear COMP2 channel interrupt flag
Writing 1 clears the C2IF flag in the COMP_SR register.
Bit 16 CC1IF: Clear COMP1 channel interrupt flag
Writing 1 clears the C1IF flag in the COMP_SR register.
Bits 15:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
